notes: Purple only where you are looking back at a session, never while you drive. 0.9.161 and 0.9.162 removed purple from the braking light, then from the gas light and the corner overall verdict - that went too far, because purple is genuinely useful when you are reading the telemetry afterwards and want your best braking point and best gas point. So: the telemetry analysis keeps purple and its legend reads "better than it" again, while every live surface draws it green - the overlay corner dots now match the Corners window, which always did. Green is on your reference, amber is between your typical lap and your best, red is below your typical. Install this rather than 0.9.162. Includes everything from 0.9.158 onwards: all four braking cases (a corner your reference takes flat is green taken flat, amber for a dab, red for real braking, and taking a braking corner flat is judged on the time you gained or lost); field events are never about your own car and are no longer logged twice; brake-point drill results reach the leaderboard; your desktop cannot end up in a highlight clip; SMART remembers the brake bias you actually ran; the finished video is named and opened from the Highlights panel; the Stint and Corners windows centre on the corner you are approaching; the Stint and Drill panels scale their text; the radar redraws at 33 ms; iRacing qualifying no longer calls cars closing behind you; and the chequered flag waits until you cross the line.
